tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List portfolio projects
tools.description: List Imtiyaz Soomro's 3D and digital media portfolio projects, optionally filtered by category.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. "Game Assets • Architecture", "Hard Surface • Concepts", or "AI-Enhanced Digital Media".

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project details
tools.description: Get the full details of one portfolio project by its id, including description, tools, client and media counts.

tools.name: get_brand_identity
tools.title: Get brand identity case studies
tools.description: Get Imtiyaz Soomro's brand identity case studies with color palettes, typography, design philosophy and live links. Omit the id to list them all.

id.description: Optional brand project id, e.g. "optimesh-solutions" or "optisync-vision".

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services offered
tools.description: List the design services Imtiyaz Soomro offers to clients (3D visuals, social media design, brand identity).

tools.name: get_about_and_contact
tools.title: Get about and contact info
tools.description: Get Imtiyaz Soomro's public bio, location, skills, tool stack and public contact links (email, LinkedIn, ArtStation).
